title: 整除是一种结构关系
Divisibility as a structural relation
text: 本节 D 始终为整环。整除依赖所在的环：在 ℤ 中 2 不整除 1，在 ℚ 中却整除。整除有传递性，且公共因子整除任意线性组合。
Throughout this section D is a domain. Divisibility depends on the ring: 2 does not divide 1 in ℤ but does in ℚ. Divisibility is transitive, and a common divisor divides every linear combination.
proof: 若 b=ax、c=ay，则 bu+cv=a(xu+yv)，所以 a 整除 bu+cv。
If b=ax and c=ay, then bu+cv=a(xu+yv).
若 b=ax、c=by，则 c=a(xy)，给出传递性。若 u 是单位，b=ax=(au)(u⁻¹x)，故 au 也整除 b。
If b=ax and c=by, then c=a(xy). If u is a unit and b=ax, then b=(au)(u⁻¹x).

title: 相伴：只差一个单位
Associates differ by a unit
text: a 与 b 互相整除称为相伴。等价地，它们生成同一主理想，或只相差一个单位因子。相伴关系是等价关系；唯一分解只要求到相伴为止。

Elements are associates when each divides the other. Equivalently they generate the same principal ideal or differ by a unit. This is an equivalence relation; factorization uniqueness is understood up to associates.
proof: 互相整除直接等价于两主理想互相包含。若两者都为 0，则 0=1·0。
Mutual divisibility is equivalent to equality of principal ideals. If both vanish, 0=1·0.
若 a≠0，写 a=ub、b=va，得 a=uva。整环消去律给出 uv=1，所以 u 是单位。
If a≠0, write a=ub and b=va. Cancellation in a=uva gives uv=1, so u is a unit.
反向 a=ub 且 u 可逆，立即给出 a|b 与 b|a。
Conversely, a=ub with u a unit gives divisibility in both directions.

title: 不可约与素元不是同一定义
Irreducible and prime mean different things
text: 两者都要求非零、非单位。不可约指 p=ab 时至少一个因子是单位；素元指 p|ab 时 p|a 或 p|b。任何整环中素元必不可约，反向需要额外条件。

Both are nonzero nonunits. An irreducible p cannot factor into two nonunits. A prime p divides a product only if it divides a factor. Prime implies irreducible in every domain, but the converse needs more.
proof: 若素元 p=ab，则 p|a 或 p|b。不妨 p|a，写 a=pc。
If p=ab is prime, p divides a or b. Suppose a=pc.
p=pcb，消去非零 p 得 cb=1，因此 b 是单位。所以 p 不可约。
Cancel p in p=pcb to get cb=1, so b is a unit.
warning: “不能再分解”谈一个元素的因子；“素”谈它如何整除别人的乘积。下一张用具体反例区分。
Irreducibility concerns the factors of one element; primality concerns its divisibility of other products. The next example separates them.

title: 范数把因子问题变成整数问题
Norms reduce factor questions to integers
text: d 为非零、非 1 的无平方因子整数，D=ℤ[√d]。范数取非负整数值，只有零元素范数为 0；单位恰为范数 1 的元素，整除必带来范数整除。
Let d be squarefree with d≠0,1 and D=ℤ[√d]. The norm is a nonnegative integer and vanishes only at zero. Units are exactly elements of norm 1, and divisibility implies divisibility of norms.
proof: 共轭 ᾱ=a−b√d 保乘法，αᾱ=a²−db²，取绝对值立即给出范数乘法性。
Conjugation preserves products, and αᾱ=a²−db², giving multiplicativity after absolute values.
若 a²=db² 且 b≠0，则 √d 为有理数，矛盾；若 b=0 则 a=0。
If a²=db² with b≠0, then √d would be rational; if b=0 then a=0.
若 αβ=1，范数乘积为 1；反向 N(α)=1 时 αᾱ=±1，故 ±ᾱ 给出逆元。
If αβ=1 the norms multiply to 1. Conversely, norm 1 means αᾱ=±1, supplying an inverse.
若 β=αγ，则 N(β)=N(α)N(γ)，从而得到范数整除。
If β=αγ, multiplicativity gives the norm divisibility.

title: 同一个 4，两条不可约分解
Two irreducible factorizations of 4
text: 在 D=ℤ[√−3] 中，2 与 1±√−3 都不可约，但两个分解不相伴。这里 2 不是素元：它整除两因子的乘积，却不整除其中任何一个。
In D=ℤ[√−3], the three elements 2 and 1±√−3 are irreducible, but the two factorizations are not associate. The element 2 is not prime: it divides the product but neither factor.
proof: 范数为 a²+3b²。方程 a²+3b²=1 只给单位 ±1；等于 2 无整数解。
The norm is a²+3b². Norm 1 gives only ±1; norm 2 has no integer solutions.
这三个元素的范数都是 4。若可分解成两个非单位，两因子范数都至少 2，只能同为 2，矛盾。因此都不可约。
All three elements have norm 4. A factorization into nonunits would require two norm-2 factors, impossible.
单位只有 ±1，2 不与 1±√−3 相伴。且 (1±√−3)/2 的系数不是整数，所以 2 不整除它们。
The only units are ±1, so 2 is not associate to either other factor. Their halves have nonintegral coefficients, so 2 divides neither.
warning: 有限网格中的范数点图只是帮助观察；无范数 2 元素的证明是 b=0 或 |b|≥1 的完整分类。
The finite lattice plot is illustrative. The proof that norm 2 is impossible uses the exhaustive cases b=0 and |b|≥1.

title: 唯一分解的两个要求
Existence and uniqueness of factorization
text: UFD 要求每个非零非单位都有不可约分解，且除重排与相伴外唯一。标准分解中 u 为单位，pᵢ 两两不相伴，eᵢ 为正整数。

A UFD requires every nonzero nonunit to factor into irreducibles, uniquely up to order and associates. In a standard factorization u is a unit, the pᵢ are pairwise nonassociate, and eᵢ are positive integers.
example: ℤ 中 60=2²·3·5。在 ℤ[√−3] 中，非单位可以按严格下降的正整数范数递归分解，故分解存在，但上一张说明唯一性失败。
In ℤ, 60=2²·3·5. In ℤ[√−3], descending positive integer norms ensure existence of irreducible factorizations, but the preceding example disproves uniqueness.

title: 在 UFD 中，不可约就是素
In a UFD, irreducibles are prime
text: UFD 的唯一性保证：不可约元出现在一个乘积的分解中，就必出现在其中一个因子的分解中。
Uniqueness of factorization ensures that an irreducible dividing a product must occur in the factorization of one of the factors.
proof: 设 p 不可约且 p|ab。若 a 或 b 为零，结论立即成立；以下设均非零，并写 ab=pc。
Let p be irreducible and ab=pc. If a or b is zero the claim is immediate; otherwise all are nonzero.
把 a,b,c 分解为单位乘不可约元；单位允许空乘积。等式 ab=pc 两边都是不可约分解。
Factor a,b,c into units and irreducibles, allowing an empty product for a unit.
唯一性迫使右侧 p 与左侧某个因子相伴；该因子来自 a 或 b，所以 p 整除相应元素。
Uniqueness makes p associate to some irreducible factor on the left, coming from a or from b.

title: 分解终止加素性，等价于 UFD
Termination plus primality characterizes UFDs
entries.tex: \begin{gathered}D\text{ UFD}\iff\\\text{proper-divisor chains terminate}\\\text{and irreducibles are prime}.\end{gathered}
text: 真因子链中，每个后继是前一项的非单位、非相伴因子。UFD 中真因子链必有限；反过来，链终止与“不可约必素”共同保证分解存在且唯一。

In a proper-divisor chain each successor is a nonunit divisor not associate to its predecessor. UFDs admit no infinite such chain. Conversely, termination and primality of irreducibles give existence and uniqueness.
proof: UFD 中，以不可约因子的总数为长度；取真因子使长度严格下降，所以链终止。不可约必素已证。
In a UFD the total number of irreducible factors strictly decreases along a proper-divisor chain; irreducibles are already known to be prime.
反向若某元素没有不可约分解，它可写成两个真因子的积，其中至少一个仍无分解。重复就得到无限真因子链，矛盾。
If an element had no irreducible factorization, one of its proper factors would also have none; repetition would produce an infinite chain.
若有两种分解，第一种的首因子为素，必整除第二种的某个不可约因子，二者因而相伴。
For two factorizations, the first prime factor divides one irreducible on the other side, hence is associate to it.
移去对应因子并消去，归纳得到全部因子一一相伴，证明唯一性。
Reorder, cancel associated factors and induct to prove uniqueness.

title: 最大公因子按整除排序
Greatest common divisors use divisibility
text: d 为 gcd(a,b) 指 d 同时整除 a,b，且任何公因子都整除 d。“最大”按整除关系理解，不是按数值大小。UFD 中总存在 gcd，且只在相伴意义下唯一。
A gcd divides both a,b and is divisible by every common divisor. “Greatest” refers to divisibility, not numerical size. A UFD always has gcds, unique up to associates.
proof: a,b 非零时，列出二者全部互不相伴的素因子，缺少的指数补 0；取每个指数的较小值得 d。
For nonzero a,b, list all prime factors appearing in either, using exponent zero when absent. Take the minimum exponent at each prime.
由指数比较，d 整除 a,b；任何公因子在每个素元处的指数不超过这两个指数，因而不超过最小值，故整除 d。
Exponent comparisons show d divides both elements and every common divisor divides d.
一个为零时可取另一个为 gcd；两者都为零可取 0。若 d,d′ 都为 gcd，则互相整除，所以相伴。
If one element is zero, take the other; for two zeros take 0. Any two gcds divide each other, so are associates.

title: 互素后的整除规则
Divisibility rules for coprime elements
entries.tex: \gcd(a,b)=1:\quad a\mid bc\Rightarrow a\mid c,\quad a\mid c,\ b\mid c\Rightarrow ab\mid c
text: UFD 中，互素元素没有共同不可约因子，因此满足所列整除规则；还可取 gcd(a,c)gcd(b,c) 与 gcd(ab,c) 相伴。
Coprime elements of a UFD share no irreducible factor. This gives the displayed divisibility rules and gcd(a,c)gcd(b,c) associate to gcd(ab,c).
proof: a、b 均非零时，对每个素元 p，互素意味着 vₚ(a)、vₚ(b) 至少一个为 0。
For nonzero a,b, coprimality says at least one of vₚ(a),vₚ(b) is zero at each prime.
a|bc 给出 vₚ(a)≤vₚ(b)+vₚ(c)，因而 vₚ(a)≤vₚ(c)。若 a,b 都整除 c，则 vₚ(a)+vₚ(b)≤vₚ(c)。
The inequalities for a|bc reduce to those for a|c; if both divide c, their disjoint prime exponents can be added.
同理 min(vₚ(a),vₚ(c))+min(vₚ(b),vₚ(c))=min(vₚ(ab),vₚ(c))，给出 gcd 乘积式。若 a 或 b 为零，互素迫使另一个是单位；若 c=0，三式也可直接验证。
The equality of the corresponding minimum exponents proves the gcd formula. If a or b is zero, coprimality makes the other a unit and the conclusions follow directly; c=0 is also immediate.
warning: UFD 中 gcd(a,b)=1 不保证能写 ua+vb=1；例如 ℤ[x] 中 2 与 x 互素，但代入 x=0 可见 2u+xv 不可能为 1。
In a UFD, coprime need not imply a Bézout identity. In ℤ[x], 2 and x are coprime, but 2u+xv=1 is impossible after setting x=0.

question: ℤ[i] 中与 2+i 相伴的是？
Which Gaussian integer is associate to 2+i?
reason: 乘以单位 i 得 i(2+i)=−1+2i。
Multiplication by the unit i gives −1+2i.

question: 任意整环中总成立的是？
Which holds in every domain?
reason: 若素元 p=ab，则 p 整除一个因子，消去 p 后另一个因子可逆。
If a prime p=ab divides one factor, cancellation makes the other a unit.

question: ℤ[√−3] 中，为什么范数 4 的元素不可约？
Why is an element of norm 4 irreducible in ℤ[√−3]?
options: 不存在范数 2 的元素
reason: 若分解为非单位，范数乘积为 4，两个整数因子只能为 2 与 2；但 a²+3b²=2 无解。
A nonunit factorization would require two norm-2 factors, but a²+3b²=2 has no integer solutions.

question: gcd(72,120) 用素因子指数如何得到？
How do prime exponents give gcd(72,120)?
reason: Use the minimum exponents in 72=2³·3² and 120=2³·3·5.

question: 证明 ℤ[x] 中 2 与 x 互素，却不存在 2u+xv=1（u,v∈ℤ[x]）。
Show that 2 and x are coprime in ℤ[x] but have no Bézout expression for 1.
reason: 公共因子 d 整除常数 2，因此为常数；又整除 x，故 d=±1。若 2u+xv=1，代入 x=0 得 2u(0)=1，矛盾。
A common divisor must be constant since it divides 2, and must be ±1 since it divides x. Evaluating a proposed identity 2u+xv=1 at zero gives the impossible equation 2u(0)=1.
